48.tq: Check each statement independently, especially the comparative claim in statement 3.
xs: All three are correct: it flows through **Maharashtra, Telangana, AP**, drains into the **Bay of Bengal** (at **Antarvedi**), and is the **longest river in AP** — option **(4) 1, 2 and 3**.
The longest-river point is the **APPSC-GS 2025** key.
xa: Origin: **Trimbakeshwar**, Nashik.
Length: **1,465 km**; India's **2nd-longest**; **"Dakshina Ganga"**.
It splits at **Dowleswaram** into the **Gautami** and **Vasishta**.

48.s: Which one of the following is the correct sequence of states traversed by the Krishna River as given in the geographical account?
o: Karnataka, Maharashtra, Andhra Pradesh and Telangana
Maharashtra, Telangana, Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh
Maharashtra, Karnataka, Telangana and Andhra Pradesh
Maharashtra, Odisha, Telangana and Andhra Pradesh
48.x: The Krishna traverses Maharashtra, Karnataka, Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.
48.tq: Test the complete state list and beware of swapping the neighbouring southern states.
xs: The Krishna flows through **Maharashtra, Karnataka, Telangana and AP** — option **(3)** is correct.
It rises in Maharashtra, so options starting with Karnataka fail; **Odisha** is not on its course.
xa: Origin: **Mahabaleshwar** (Krishna Kund), Western Ghats.
Length ~**1,400 km**; ~**485 km** in AP (**720 km** in TS + AP).
It meets the sea at **Hamsaladeevi**.

48.s: The Krishna River rises at Krishna Kund near
48.x: The Krishna originates at Krishna Kund near Mahabaleshwar in the Western Ghats.
48.tq: Match the river with its specific source locality rather than a general mountain range.
xs: The **Krishna** rises at **Krishna Kund**, **Mahabaleshwar**, in the Western Ghats — option **(2)** is correct.
**Trimbakeshwar** is the **Godavari**'s source; **Jayapur** is the **Vamsadhara**'s; **Nandidurga** the **Penna**'s.
xa: The **Tungabhadra** (from the **Varaha hills**) joins it at **Sangameswaram**.
The Krishna splits at **Puligadda**, **64 km** below Vijayawada.
**Prakasam Barrage** is on the Krishna at **Vijayawada**.

48.s: The Vamsadhara River originates in the
48.x: The Vamsadhara originates in the Jayapur hills of Kalahandi district in Odisha.
48.tq: Use the exact hill and district association for the river’s origin.
xs: The **Vamsadhara** rises in the **Jayapur hills** of **Kalahandi** (Odisha) — option **(2)** is correct.
**Nandidurga** is the **Penna**'s source; **Mudugal** the **Machkund**'s; **Mahendragiri** the **Mahendra Tanaya**'s.
xa: **APPSC-G2 2025** match: Vamsadhara-**Jayapur**, Machkund-**Mudugal**, Gundlakamma-**Nallamala**, Pennar-**Nandidurga**.
It enters AP at **Pathapatnam** and meets the sea at **Kalingapatnam**.
Length: **254 km**.

48.s: Which one of the following statements about the Vamsadhara River is correct?
o: It flows between the Krishna and Penna basins and enters Andhra Pradesh near Nellore.
It is a tributary of the Krishna and enters Andhra Pradesh near Hamsaladeevi.
It originates in the Nallamala hills and flows only within Andhra Pradesh.
It flows between the Rushikulya and Godavari basins and enters Andhra Pradesh near Pathapatnam.
48.x: The Vamsadhara lies between the Rushikulya and Godavari basins and enters Andhra Pradesh near Pathapatnam.
48.tq: Use basin position and entry point together to identify the correct river description.
xs: The **Vamsadhara** flows between the **Rushikulya and Godavari** basins and enters AP at **Pathapatnam** — option **(4)** is correct.
It is not a Krishna tributary (**Hamsaladeevi** is the Krishna mouth), and it rises in **Odisha**, not the Nallamala.
xa: It is the **biggest river rising in the Eastern Ghats**.
It meets the sea at **Kalingapatnam**.
**Gotta Barrage** (Srikakulam) is on the Vamsadhara.

48.s: Which river is described as the biggest river rising in the Eastern Ghats?
48.x: The Vamsadhara is described as the biggest river rising in the Eastern Ghats.
48.tq: Identify the superlative claim and distinguish it from rivers merely associated with the Eastern Ghats.
xs: The **Vamsadhara** is the **biggest river rising in the Eastern Ghats** — option **(3)** is correct.
**Nagavali** (**256 km**) and **Gosthani** (~**120 km**) are smaller; **Gundlakamma** rises in the **Nallamala**.
xa: Vamsadhara length: **254 km**; source **Jayapur hills**, Kalahandi.
**Vamsadhara Water Disputes Tribunal** (AP-Odisha): final award **2017**.
**Vamsadhara-Nagavali link**: **73%** done; target **June 2027**.

48.s: The Nagavali River is also called
48.x: Nagavali is also known as Langulya.
48.tq: Test alternate names of neighbouring rivers directly.
xs: The **Nagavali** is also called **Langulya** — option **(1)** is correct.
**Mogaleru** is the **Swarnamukhi** (in Dhurjati's works); **Pinakini** is the **Penna**; **Sileru** is the lower course of the **Machkund**.
xa: Nagavali: **256 km** total, **95 km** in AP.
It flows through **Vizianagaram and Srikakulam**, reaching the sea near **Mofar Bandar**.
**Thotapalli** project (Parvathipuram Manyam) is on the Nagavali.

48.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
48.x: Tungabhadra does not fall at Antarvedi; it joins the Krishna at Sangameswaram. Antarvedi is associated with the Godavari outfall.
48.tq: Find the wrongly assigned mouth or confluence among otherwise familiar river-location pairs.
xs: **Tungabhadra — Antarvedi** is wrong — option **(4)** is the answer: the Tungabhadra joins the **Krishna** at **Sangameswaram** (Kurnool).
**Antarvedi** is the **Godavari**'s outfall (Vasishta branch).
The rest are right: **Nagavali** — Mofar Bandar; **Vamsadhara** — Kalingapatnam; **Krishna** — Hamsaladeevi.
xa: Tungabhadra: **531 km**, ~**149 km** in AP; from the **Varaha hills**.
**Sunkesula Barrage** (Kurnool) is on the Tungabhadra.
The **Raichur Doab** lies between the Krishna and Tungabhadra.

48.s: The Tungabhadra River originates in the
o: Varaha hills of the Western Ghats
48.x: The Tungabhadra originates in the Varaha hills of the Western Ghats.
48.tq: Match the river with its source hills and reject origins belonging to nearby peninsular rivers.
xs: The **Tungabhadra** rises in the **Varaha hills** of the **Western Ghats** — option **(1)** is correct.
**Bheemunipatnam** is the **Gosthani** estuary; **Nandidurga** is the **Penna**'s source; **Jayapur** the **Vamsadhara**'s.
xa: It joins the Krishna at **Sangameswaram**.
**Tungabhadra Dam** is at **Hosapete, Karnataka**; AP's **TBP-HLC** is fed from it.
The **KC Canal** starts at **Sunkesula** on the Tungabhadra.

48.s: The Tungabhadra joins the Krishna River at
48.x: The Tungabhadra joins the Krishna at Sangameswaram.
48.tq: Distinguish a tributary confluence from a river’s final outfall into the sea.
xs: The **Tungabhadra** joins the **Krishna** at **Sangameswaram** (Kurnool) — option **(2)** is correct.
**Kalingapatnam** = Vamsadhara mouth; **Antarvedi** = Godavari mouth; **Hamsaladeevi** = Krishna mouth.
xa: Tungabhadra length: **531 km**.
The **Raichur Doab** lies between the two rivers.
**Srisailam** on the Krishna is in **Nandyal** (erstwhile Kurnool).

48.s: Machkund River is associated with which one of the following combinations?
o: Mudugal hills, Duduma Falls and Machkund hydel project
Nallamala hills, Cumbum tank and Bay of Bengal
Jayapur hills, Kalingapatnam and Mahendra Tanaya
48.x: Machkund originates in the Mudugal hills and is associated with Duduma Falls and the Machkund hydel project.
48.tq: Combine three linked identifiers to distinguish a river from its neighbouring counterparts.
xs: **Machkund** = **Mudugal (Madugula) hills**, **Duduma falls** and the **Machkund hydel project** — option **(1)** is correct.
**Nallamala / Cumbum tank** is the **Gundlakamma**; **Jayapur / Kalingapatnam** the **Vamsadhara**; **Bheemunipatnam / Khondalites** the **Gosthani**.
xa: Machkund is the **upper Sileru** and joins the **Sabari**.
Its source is in **ASR** district.
It is shared by **AP and Odisha**.

48.s: Cumbum tank is associated with which river?
48.x: Cumbum tank is situated on the Gundlakamma River, which originates in the Nallamala hills.
48.tq: Link a reservoir or tank with the river on which it is situated.
xs: **Cumbum tank** is on the **Gundlakamma** — option **(4)** is correct.
The **Gundlakamma** rises in the **Nallamala hills** and flows to the Bay of Bengal.
**Swarnamukhi**, **Nagavali** and **Gosthani** have no link to Cumbum in the notes.
xa: Cumbum tank is in **Prakasam**.
**Anantaraja Sagar tank** is in **YSR Kadapa** (**APPSC-GS 2025**).
**Veligonda** takes Srisailam water to the **Gundlakamma basin** through Nallamala tunnels.

48.s: The Gosthani River is correctly described as a river that
o: originates near Tirupati and drains at Utukuru
originates in Odisha and enters the sea at Kalingapatnam
originates in the Western Ghats and joins the Krishna at Sangameswaram
originates in the Eastern Ghats and forms an estuary near Bheemunipatnam
48.x: The Gosthani originates in the Eastern Ghats, has a length of about 120 km and forms an estuary near Bheemunipatnam.
48.tq: Combine origin, approximate length and outfall to identify the correct description.
xs: The **Gosthani** rises in the **Eastern Ghats** and forms an **estuary near Bheemunipatnam** — option **(4)** is correct.
**Utukuru** is the **Penna** mouth; **Kalingapatnam** the **Vamsadhara**'s; **Sangameswaram** is where the **Tungabhadra** joins the Krishna.
xa: Gosthani is ~**120 km** long.
Its basin lies on **Khondalites**.
**Katiki** falls (near Borra Caves) is on the Gosthani course.

48.s:
Consider the following statements about the Swarnamukhi river:
1. It rises near Pakala in the Tirupati region.
2. Tirumala and Srikalahasti lie in its basin.
3. It is called 'Langulya' in Dhurjati's works.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
48.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is wrong: Dhurjati calls it 'Mogaleru'; Langulya is another name of the Nagavali. So '1 and 2 only'; options including 3 are wrong, and '1 and 3 only'/'2 and 3 only' drop a true statement.
48.tq: Swarnamukhi = Mogaleru; Nagavali = Langulya; Penna = Pinakini.
xs: Statement 1 is correct: the **Swarnamukhi** rises near **Pakala (Tirupati)**.
Statement 2 is correct: **Tirumala and Srikalahasti** lie in its basin — option **(1) 1 and 2 only**.
Statement 3 is wrong: Dhurjati calls it **"Mogaleru"**; **Langulya** is the **Nagavali**.
xa: A dam is on its tributary **Kalyani**.
**Nagavali-Suvarnamukhi** (4 rivers) link: **19.32%** done, for Vizianagaram drinking water.
**Pinakini** is the **Penna**.

48.s: Mahendra Tanaya is a tributary of the
48.x: Mahendra Tanaya, which originates in the Mahendragiri hills, is a tributary of the Vamsadhara.
48.tq: Distinguish a tributary relationship from a shared-state relationship.
xs: **Mahendra Tanaya** is a tributary of the **Vamsadhara** — option **(4)** is correct.
It rises in the **Mahendragiri hills** (Odisha) and is shared by **Odisha and AP**.
xa: The Vamsadhara rises in the **Jayapur hills** and meets the sea at **Kalingapatnam**.
**Gotta Barrage** on the Vamsadhara is in **Srikakulam**.
Bahuda and Mahendra Tanaya are both shared with **Odisha**.

48.s:
Arrange the following rivers in descending order of their total length:
A. Godavari
B. Krishna
C. Penna
D. Vamsadhara
48.x: The total lengths are Godavari 1,465 km, Krishna about 1,400 km, Penna 597 km and Vamsadhara 254 km. Therefore, the correct order is A, B, C, D.
48.tq: Rank the rivers by their stated numerical lengths before comparing the options.
xs: Total length: **Godavari 1,465 km > Krishna ~1,400 km > Penna 597 km > Vamsadhara 254 km** — option **(1) A, B, C, D**.
The Krishna is shorter than the Godavari, so options starting with B fail.
xa: Lengths in AP: Godavari ~**250 km**, Krishna ~**485 km**, Penna **536 km**.
⚠ The **Penna** flows **536 km** in AP (**APPSC-GS 2025**).
The **Nagavali** is **256 km**.

48.s: Which one of the following statements about the Godavari is correct?
o: It rises at Mahabaleshwar and meets the sea at Hamsaladeevi.
It rises at Trimbakeshwar (Nashik) and meets the Bay of Bengal at Antarvedi.
It rises in the Jayapur hills and meets the sea at Kalingapatnam.
It rises in the Varaha hills and joins the Krishna at Sangameswaram.
48.x: The Godavari rises at Trimbakeshwar near Nashik, runs 1,465 km and meets the Bay of Bengal at Antarvedi; it is called 'Dakshina Ganga'. Mahabaleshwar-Hamsaladeevi is the Krishna, Jayapur-Kalingapatnam the Vamsadhara, and Varaha hills-Sangameswaram the Tungabhadra.
48.tq: Godavari: Trimbakeshwar to Antarvedi.
xs: The **Godavari** rises at **Trimbakeshwar (Nashik)** and meets the **Bay of Bengal** at **Antarvedi** — option **(2)** is correct.
**Mahabaleshwar–Hamsaladeevi** is the **Krishna**; **Jayapur–Kalingapatnam** the **Vamsadhara**; **Varaha hills–Sangameswaram** the **Tungabhadra**.
xa: Length **1,465 km**; India's **2nd-longest**; **"Dakshina Ganga"**.
The **Gautami** branch reaches the sea at **Yanam**.
**Sir Arthur Cotton Barrage** at **Dowleswaram** was built in **1852**.

48.s: The Penna River is also known as
48.x: The Penna is also known as the Pinakini.
48.tq: Discriminate among alternate names of rivers occurring in the same region.
xs: The **Penna** is also called **Pinakini** (Pennar) — option **(4)** is correct.
**Mogaleru** = Swarnamukhi; **Langulya** = Nagavali; **Mahendra Tanaya** is a Vamsadhara tributary.
xa: It rises in the **Nandidurga hills**, Karnataka.
It is the **lifeline of Rayalaseema**.
**Somasila** dam (Nellore) is on the Penna.

48.s:
Consider the following statements about the Penna (Pennar) river:
1. It rises in the Nandidurga hills of Karnataka.
2. Of its 597 km length, about 536 km lies in Andhra Pradesh.
3. It falls into the Bay of Bengal at Hamsaladeevi.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
48.x: Statement 1 is correct: the Penna rises in the Nandidurga hills. Statement 2 is correct: 536 km of 597 km lies in AP. Statement 3 is wrong: the Penna meets the sea at Utukuru (Nellore); Hamsaladeevi is the Krishna's mouth. So '1 and 2 only'; the other options include statement 3 or omit a true statement.
48.tq: Mouths: Godavari-Antarvedi, Krishna-Hamsaladeevi, Penna-Utukuru, Vamsadhara-Kalingapatnam.
xs: Statement 1 is correct: the Penna rises in the **Nandidurga hills**, Karnataka.
Statement 2 is correct: **536 km** of its **597 km** is in AP — option **(1) 1 and 2 only**.
Statement 3 is wrong: it meets the sea at **Utukuru (Nellore)**; **Hamsaladeevi** is the **Krishna**'s mouth.
xa: It enters AP in **Anantapur**.
It cuts the **Gandikota** gorge in **YSR Kadapa**.
⚠ Some notes place Utukuru in Palnadu; **Nellore** is correct.

48.s: Gandikota gorge is formed by the Penna River in:
48.x: Gandikota gorge, also called the Gandikota canyon, is formed by the Penna in YSR Kadapa district.
48.tq: Match the landform with its river and district.
xs: The Penna cuts the **Gandikota** gorge (**"canyon"**) in **YSR Kadapa** — option **(1)** is correct.
**Nellore** is its mouth (**Utukuru**); it enters AP in **Anantapur**.
xa: Gandikota is one of **7** tourism anchor hubs (CDI SES 2025-26).
The **Chitravathi** joins the Penna at **Gandikota**.
The Penna is the **lifeline of Rayalaseema**.

48.s: Through which district does the Penna enter Andhra Pradesh?
48.x: The Penna enters Andhra Pradesh in Anantapur district.
48.tq: Separate the river’s entry district from its later gorge and outfall locations.
xs: The Penna enters AP in **Anantapur** — option **(4)** is correct.
It cuts the gorge in **Kadapa** and meets the sea in **Nellore**.
xa: It rises in the **Nandidurga hills**, Karnataka.
Length: **597 km** total, **536 km** in AP.
The **Chitravathi** (with **Puttaparthi** on it) is a tributary.

48.s:
Consider the following statements about the Kundu (Kunderu), a tributary of the Penna:
1. It rises at Uppalapadu in Kurnool.
2. Its valley is called Renadu.
3. It is known as the 'Sorrow of Kadapa'.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
48.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is wrong: the Kundu is the 'Sorrow of Nandyal'. So '1 and 2 only'; options containing 3 are wrong, and the remaining option drops a true statement.
48.tq: Kundu = Sorrow of Nandyal, valley Renadu; Cheyyeru = Bahuda + Pancha.
xs: Statement 1 is correct: the **Kundu (Kunderu)** rises at **Uppalapadu (Kurnool)**.
Statement 2 is correct: its valley is called **Renadu** — option **(1) 1 and 2 only**.
Statement 3 is wrong: it is the **"Sorrow of Nandyal"**, not Kadapa.
xa: Other Penna tributaries: **Chitravathi, Papagni, Cheyyeru, Sagileru**.
The **Sagileru** joins near **Kamalapuram**.
The **Cheyyeru** joins at **Gundlamada** (Kadapa).

48.s: Which one of the following statements regarding the Chitravathi River is correct?
o: It joins the Penna near Kamalapuram.
It is formed by the Bahuda and Pancha rivers and joins at Gundlamada.
It rises at Uppalapadu and is called the Sorrow of Nandyal.
It rises in Chikkaballapur, flows by Puttaparthi and joins the Penna at Gandikota.
48.x: The Chitravathi originates in Chikkaballapur, Puttaparthi lies on it, and it joins the Penna at Gandikota.
48.tq: Use the long, precise river-course option and distinguish it from tributary facts deliberately swapped between rivers.
xs: The **Chitravathi** rises in **Chikkaballapur**, has **Puttaparthi** on it and joins at **Gandikota** — option **(4)** is correct.
**Kamalapuram** is the **Sagileru**; **Bahuda + Pancha / Gundlamada** is the **Cheyyeru**; **Uppalapadu / Sorrow of Nandyal** is the **Kundu**.
xa: The **Papagni** also comes from **Chikkaballapur** via the **Nandi Hills** (right bank).
Gandikota gorge is in **YSR Kadapa**.
The **Annamayya dam** is on the Cheyyeru.

48.s: Which of the following is a right-bank tributary of the Penna originating from Chikkaballapur via the Nandi Hills?
48.x: Papagni is a right-bank tributary of the Penna and originates from Chikkaballapur via the Nandi Hills.
48.tq: Combine bank position with source location to distinguish closely related tributaries.
xs: The **Papagni** is the **right-bank** tributary from **Chikkaballapur** via the **Nandi Hills** — option **(1)** is correct.
⚠ The **Chitravathi** also starts in Chikkaballapur but is identified by **Puttaparthi** and **Gandikota**, not as right bank.
**Sagileru** joins near **Kamalapuram**; **Kundu** rises at **Uppalapadu**.
xa: The **Cheyyeru** is formed by the **Bahuda + Pancha**.
The Kundu valley is **Renadu**.
The Penna rises in the **Nandidurga hills**.

48.s: The Cheyyeru River is formed by the confluence of:
48.x: The Cheyyeru is formed by the Bahuda and Pancha rivers.
48.tq: Test the formation pair directly while using other Penna tributaries as plausible distractors.
xs: The **Cheyyeru** is formed by the **Bahuda + Pancha** — option **(3)** is correct.
**Chitravathi, Sagileru, Kundu, Papagni** are separate Penna tributaries.
xa: It joins the Penna at **Gundlamada** (Kadapa).
The **Annamayya dam** is on it.
⚠ The **Bahuda** is also named among rivers shared with **Odisha**.

48.s:
Which one of the following combinations is correctly matched?
1. Cheyyeru — Gundlamada
2. Cheyyeru — Annamayya dam
3. Sagileru — near Kamalapuram
4. Chitravathi — Gandikota
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
48.x: Cheyyeru joins at Gundlamada in Kadapa and is associated with the Annamayya dam; Sagileru joins near Kamalapuram, while Chitravathi joins at Gandikota.
48.tq: Recognise a complete cluster of location associations rather than isolating only the most familiar pair.
xs: All four are correct: **Cheyyeru** — **Gundlamada** and the **Annamayya dam**; **Sagileru** — near **Kamalapuram**; **Chitravathi** — **Gandikota** — option **(4) 1, 2, 3 and 4**.
Each pair matches the Penna tributary table.
xa: **Puttaparthi** lies on the Chitravathi.
**Papagni** is a right-bank tributary.
The **Kundu** is the **"Sorrow of Nandyal"**.

48.s: The Penna (Pennar) meets the Bay of Bengal at Utukuru, which lies in which district?
48.x: The Penna meets the Bay of Bengal at Utukuru in Nellore district. Some sources wrongly place Utukuru in Palnadu, which is inland. Prakasam and Bapatla are coastal districts to the north and do not hold the Penna mouth.
48.tq: Penna mouth = Utukuru, Nellore.
xs: **Utukuru** is in **Nellore** — option **(3)** is correct.
⚠ Some notes place Utukuru in **Palnadu**; **Nellore** is correct.
xa: The Penna has a **small delta** in Nellore.
⚠ Some notes wrongly place **Pulicat** at the Penna mouth.
**Somasila** dam (SPSR Nellore) adds **38,406 acres** of new ayacut.

48.s: At Dowleswaram, the Godavari divides into which two principal distributaries?
48.x: At Dowleswaram, the Godavari splits into the two main distributaries, Gautami and Vasishta.
48.tq: Distinguish principal distributaries from the other mouths of the delta.
xs: At **Dowleswaram** the Godavari splits into **2** main distributaries, **Gautami and Vasishta** — option **(3)** is correct.
**Tammileru** drains into Kolleru; **Bharadwaja, Tulya, Athreya, Vainateya, Koushika** are among the **7 mouths**, not the two main branches.
xa: This was the **APPSC 2025** answer (**2**).
**Gautami** reaches the sea at **Yanam**; **Vasishta** at **Antarvedi**.
⚠ Godavari splits at **Dowleswaram**; Krishna at **Puligadda**.

48.s: Which one of the following distributary-mouth pairs is correctly matched?
48.x: The Gautami reaches the sea at Yanam, while the Vasishta reaches the sea at Antarvedi. The other listed mouths are incorrectly paired.
48.tq: Start from the sure river-mouth pair and eliminate swapped locations.
xs: **Gautami — sea at Yanam** is correct — option **(1)** is correct.
The **Vasishta** reaches the sea at **Antarvedi**, not Kakinada; **Bharadwaja** is at **Bendamoorlanka**.
xa: The **7 mouths**: Gautami, Vasishta, **Vainateya, Tulya, Bharadwaja, Kaushika, Athreya**.
**Konaseema** lies between the Gautami and Vasishta.
**Yanam** is a Puducherry enclave in the Godavari basin list.

48.s: Which of the following is NOT included among the seven mouths of the Godavari delta?
48.x: The seven mouths include Gautami, Vasishta, Vainateya, Tulya, Bharadwaja, Kaushika and Athreya. Tammileru is a stream that drains into Kolleru Lake.
48.tq: Identify the non-member of a named distributary list.
xs: **Tammileru** is not a Godavari mouth — option **(4)** is the answer; it drains into **Kolleru**.
The **7 mouths**: **Gautami, Vasishta, Vainateya, Tulya, Bharadwaja, Kaushika, Athreya**.
xa: The Tammileru basin is shared by **AP and Telangana**.
**Bharadwaja** reaches the sea at **Bendamoorlanka**.
The two main distributaries split at **Dowleswaram**.

48.s: Diviseema is located:
o: Between the two branches formed when the Krishna splits at Puligadda
At the confluence of the Pennar and the Godavari
Between the Krishna and Tungabhadra at Sangameswaram
Between the Gautami and Vasishta branches of the Godavari
48.x: Diviseema, also called Divi island, lies between the two branches of the Krishna formed at Puligadda.
48.tq: Distinguish islands formed by the Krishna from delta features of the Godavari.
xs: **Diviseema (Divi island)** lies between the two branches of the **Krishna** that split at **Puligadda** — option **(1)** is correct.
The land between **Gautami and Vasishta** is **Konaseema** (Godavari); **Sangameswaram** is the Krishna-Tungabhadra confluence.
xa: Puligadda is **64 km** below **Vijayawada**.
Diviseema is in **Krishna** district; hit by the **1977** cyclone.
The Krishna reaches the sea at **Hamsaladeevi**.

48.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Konaseema — Godavari delta between Gautami and Vasishta
48.x: Konaseema is the Godavari delta region between the Gautami and Vasishta branches. Diviseema and Bhavani Island are associated with the Krishna, while Gandikota is on the Penna.
48.tq: Match each island or landform with its river before checking its location.
xs: **Konaseema — Godavari delta between Gautami and Vasishta** is correct — option **(1)** is correct.
**Diviseema** is a **Krishna** delta island; **Bhavani Island** is on the **Krishna** at Vijayawada; **Gandikota** is on the **Penna**.
xa: Konaseema's silt islands are called **"lankas"**.
The **Raichur Doab** lies between the Krishna and Tungabhadra.
Diviseema was hit by the **1977** cyclone.

48.s: The term ‘lankas’ in the Konaseema region refers to:
o: Sand dunes at the mouth of the Krishna
Canals linking the Krishna and Pennar
Rocky gorges formed by river erosion
Silt islands in the Godavari delta
48.x: The lankas are silt islands of the Godavari delta in the Konaseema region.
48.tq: Test the exact local geographical meaning of a distinctive term.
xs: **"Lankas"** are the **silt islands** of the **Godavari delta** in **Konaseema** — option **(4)** is correct.
They are not dunes, canals or gorges per the notes.
xa: Konaseema lies between the **Gautami and Vasishta**.
Source: **CDCA Jul 2026**.
The Godavari splits at **Dowleswaram**.

48.s: Bhavani Island is located on the Krishna near:
48.x: Bhavani Island is a Krishna river island near Prakasam Barrage at Vijayawada and is used as a tourism destination.
48.tq: Combine the river, nearby structure and city to identify the island.
xs: **Bhavani Island** is a Krishna river island at **Vijayawada**, near **Prakasam Barrage** — option **(2)** is correct.
**Puligadda** is where the Krishna bifurcates; **Hamsaladeevi** is its mouth; **Sangameswaram** is the Tungabhadra confluence.
xa: Bhavani Island is a **tourism** site.
**Prakasam Barrage** is Cotton's **Krishna Upper Anicut** (**1850s**); crest-gate telemetry installed **Feb 2026**.
**Diviseema** is the Krishna's delta island.

48.s: The 1977 cyclone is specifically associated with which of the following features?
48.x: Diviseema is associated with the 1977 cyclone.
48.tq: Link a historical event with the correct geographical feature.
xs: The **1977 cyclone** is linked to **Diviseema** — option **(3)** is correct.
**Konaseema** is the Godavari delta; **Kolleru** a freshwater lake; **Gandikota** a Penna gorge.
xa: Diviseema (**Divi island**) is in **Krishna** district.
It lies between the two Krishna branches below **Puligadda**.
**Bhavani Island** is another Krishna island, at Vijayawada.

48.s: The Raichur Doab lies between which two rivers?
48.x: The Raichur Doab is the land between the Krishna and the Tungabhadra. The Godavari-Krishna interfluve holds Kolleru lake, and the Penna is a separate southern basin not forming this doab with either river.
48.tq: Raichur Doab = Krishna + Tungabhadra.
xs: The **Raichur Doab** lies between the **Krishna and Tungabhadra** — option **(2)** is correct.
The other river pairs do not form the Raichur Doab per the notes.
xa: The Tungabhadra joins the Krishna at **Sangameswaram** (Kurnool).
**Tungabhadra Dam** is at **Hosapete, Karnataka**.
**Sunkesula Barrage** on the Tungabhadra heads the **KC Canal**.

48.s: Polavaram National Project is constructed across which river?
48.x: Polavaram is a multipurpose dam constructed on the Godavari River. It is located at Polavaram village in the erstwhile West Godavari district.
48.tq: Use the river–project association to eliminate neighbouring basin names.
xs: **Polavaram** is on the **Godavari** — option **(4)** is correct.
It is at **Polavaram village**, erstwhile **West Godavari** district.
**Somasila** is the **Penna** project; **Gotta** the **Vamsadhara**; **Srisailam** and **Nagarjuna Sagar** the **Krishna**.
xa: It is a **National Project under Sec. 90, APRA 2014** (⚠ not Sec. 89).
Design: **194.6 TMC**, **7.20 lakh acres**, **960 MW**, **80 TMC** to the Krishna.
**89% complete**; to be dedicated by **March 2027**.

48.s: Sir Arthur Cotton Barrage is located at which place on the Godavari River?
48.x: Sir Arthur Cotton Barrage is situated at Dowleswaram near Rajahmundry on the Godavari River. Cotton built the anicut in 1852.
48.tq: Test the exact location rather than merely identifying the river.
xs: **Sir Arthur Cotton Barrage** is at **Dowleswaram, Rajahmundry** (Rajamahendravaram), East Godavari — option **(2)** is correct.
**Sunkesula** is on the **Tungabhadra**; **Gotta** on the **Vamsadhara**; **Nandikonda** is the **Nagarjuna Sagar** site on the Krishna.
xa: Cotton's anicut was built in **1852**; it feeds the **Eastern, Central and Western** deltas (**10.30 lakh acres**).
**117** new gates (**₹152.95 crore**) before **Pushkarams 2027**.
**5.2 lakh cusecs** were discharged at Dowleswaram in the **Jul 2026** floods.

48.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
48.x: Gotta Barrage is constructed on the Vamsadhara River in Srikakulam district. Thotapalli is associated with the Nagavali River and Parvathipuram Manyam district.
48.tq: Find the swapped river in a project–river–district triple.
xs: **Gotta Barrage — Nagavali** is wrong — option **(4)** is the answer: **Gotta** is on the **Vamsadhara** (Srikakulam).
The rest are right: **Thotapalli** — Nagavali — Parvathipuram Manyam; **Srisailam** — Krishna — Nandyal; **Somasila** — Penna — SPSR Nellore.
xa: ⚠ **Thotapalli** = Nagavali; **Gotta** = Vamsadhara; **Sunkesula** = Tungabhadra; **Somasila** = Penna.
Both Gotta and Thotapalli serve **North Coastal AP**; good inflows reported in **Aug 2026**.
**Somasila** adds **38,406 acres** of new ayacut.

48.s:
Consider the following statements regarding projects on the Krishna River:
1. Srisailam is located on the Nandyal side of the Andhra Pradesh–Telangana region.
2. Nagarjuna Sagar is situated near Nandikonda.
3. Pulichintala is located in Palnadu district.
4. Prakasam Barrage is located at Vijayawada.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
48.x: All four statements are correct. Srisailam, Nagarjuna Sagar, Pulichintala and Prakasam Barrage are listed as Krishna basin structures at the stated locations.
48.tq: Verify each project–location pair before selecting the coded combination.
xs: All four are correct: **Srisailam** — **Nandyal** (AP-Telangana); **Nagarjuna Sagar** — near **Nandikonda**; **Pulichintala** — **Palnadu**; **Prakasam Barrage** — **Vijayawada** — option **(4) 1, 2, 3 and 4**.
Each matches the notes' project table for the **Krishna**.
xa: **Srisailam** is the source for **Telugu Ganga, HNSS and Veligonda**.
**Nagarjuna Sagar** spans **Palnadu (AP) / Nalgonda (TS)**.
**El Nino** (**25 Aug 2026**): KRMB limited Srisailam and Nagarjunasagar water to **drinking only**.

48.s: Sunkesula Barrage, which serves as the head of the KC Canal, is constructed on the:
48.x: Sunkesula Barrage is constructed on the Tungabhadra River in Kurnool district and forms the head of the KC Canal.
48.tq: Combine the structure, river and canal clue to identify the correct option.
xs: **Sunkesula Barrage** (Kurnool) is on the **Tungabhadra** — option **(4)** is correct.
It heads the **KC (Kurnool-Cuddapah) Canal**, serving **Kurnool and Kadapa**.
xa: ⚠ **Somasila** is the **Penna** project; **Dowleswaram** the **Godavari**'s.
**Tungabhadra Dam** is at **Hosapete, Karnataka**.
The Tungabhadra joins the Krishna at **Sangameswaram**.

48.s:
Which of the following statements regarding the Sir Arthur Cotton Barrage is correct?
1. It was built in 1852.
2. It feeds the Eastern, Central and Western deltas.
3. It has an irrigation coverage of 10.30 lakh acres as stated.
4. It is located on the Vamsadhara River.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
48.x: Statements 1, 2 and 3 are correct. Statement 4 is false because the Sir Arthur Cotton Barrage is on the Godavari River, not the Vamsadhara.
48.tq: Find the wrong river statement in an otherwise correct project description.
xs: Statements 1–3 are correct: built **1852**; feeds the **Eastern, Central and Western** deltas; **10.30 lakh acres** — option **(2) 1, 2 and 3 only**.
Statement 4 is wrong: the barrage is on the **Godavari** at **Dowleswaram**, not the Vamsadhara.
xa: The **Vamsadhara**'s barrage is **Gotta** (Srikakulam).
**117** new gates are planned before **Pushkarams 2027**.
At Dowleswaram the Godavari splits into **Gautami and Vasishta**.

48.s:
Which of the following statements correctly describes the relationship between Tungabhadra Dam and Andhra Pradesh?
1. The dam is located at Hosapete in Karnataka.
2. Andhra Pradesh’s TBP-HLC is fed from it.
3. The dam is constructed on the Penna River.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
48.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is false because Tungabhadra Dam is on the Tungabhadra River, not the Penna.
48.tq: Separate a project’s location and beneficiary canal from its river identity.
xs: Statement 1 is correct: the **Tungabhadra Dam** is at **Hosapete, Karnataka**.
Statement 2 is correct: AP's **TBP-HLC** is fed from it — option **(2) 1 and 2 only**.
Statement 3 is wrong: it is on the **Tungabhadra**, not the Penna.
xa: The Tungabhadra rises in the **Varaha hills**; **531 km** long.
**Sunkesula** on the Tungabhadra heads the **KC Canal**.
The **Raichur Doab** lies between the Krishna and Tungabhadra.

48.s: What irrigation potential was created in Andhra Pradesh as of December 2024, according to the stated distribution?
48.x: The total irrigation potential created was 106.15 lakh acres. Its stated components were 66.81 lakh acres major, 5.62 lakh acres medium and 25.60 lakh acres minor.
48.tq: Select the total rather than one of the component figures.
xs: Irrigation potential created by **Dec 2024** was **106.15 lakh acres** — option **(2)** is correct.
⚠ The other options are its parts: **major 66.81**, **medium 5.62**, **minor 25.60** lakh acres.
xa: Source: **2024-25** data.
**Polavaram** alone is designed for **7.20 lakh acres**.
**Veligonda** is to irrigate ~**4.47 lakh acres**.

48.s:
Consider the following pairs:
1. Anantaraja Sagar tank — YSR Kadapa
2. Cumbum tank — Prakasam
3. Sunkesula Barrage — SPSR Nellore
Which of the pairs given above is/are correctly matched?
48.x: Pair 1 is correct: Anantaraja Sagar tank is in YSR Kadapa (APPSC-GS 2025). Pair 2 is correct: Cumbum tank, on the Gundlakamma, is in Prakasam. Pair 3 is wrong: Sunkesula Barrage is in Kurnool on the Tungabhadra; Somasila is the Nellore project. So '1 and 2 only'.
48.tq: Anantaraja Sagar = Kadapa; Cumbum = Prakasam.
xs: Pair 1 is correct: **Anantaraja Sagar tank** — **YSR Kadapa** (**APPSC-GS 2025**).
Pair 2 is correct: **Cumbum tank** (on the **Gundlakamma**) — **Prakasam** — option **(2) 1 and 2 only**.
Pair 3 is wrong: **Sunkesula** is in **Kurnool** on the Tungabhadra; the Nellore project is **Somasila**.
xa: The Gundlakamma rises in the **Nallamala hills**.
Exam angle: "Anantaraja Sagar / Cumbum tank is in which district / on which river".
**Somasila** is on the **Penna**.

48.s: Pattiseema lift scheme transfers Godavari water to the Krishna at which location?
48.x: Pattiseema lifts Godavari water into the Polavaram Right Main Canal, which carries it to the Krishna at Prakasam Barrage.
48.tq: Identify the destination structure in a river-transfer scheme.
xs: **Pattiseema** sends Godavari water to the **Krishna** at **Prakasam Barrage** — option **(1)** is correct.
It lifts water into the **Polavaram Right Main Canal**, which carries it to Prakasam Barrage.
xa: It is a **lift irrigation** scheme (**APPSC-GS 2018**).
It diverted **17.52 tmc ft** by **10 Aug 2026**, while ~**521 tmc ft** of Godavari water flowed to sea.
Telangana objects to **Pattiseema**, Polavaram and Banakacherla.

48.s: Pattiseema is primarily classified as a:
48.x: Pattiseema is a lift irrigation scheme that transfers Godavari water into the Polavaram Right Main Canal.
48.tq: Discriminate between a lift scheme, a canal and a dam project.
xs: **Pattiseema** is a **lift irrigation** scheme — option **(1)** is correct.
It is not a gravity canal, dam or waterway: it **lifts** Godavari water into the **Polavaram Right Main Canal**.
xa: Asked in **APPSC-GS 2018**.
The water reaches the Krishna at **Prakasam Barrage**.
**Godavari-Penna Phase-I** is also a lift (**5-stage**, **73 TMC**).

48.s: Which of the following statements regarding the Polavaram Left Main Canal is correct?
o: It carries Pennar water to Chennai through Poondi.
It carries Tungabhadra water to Kurnool and Kadapa.
It carries Krishna water to Rayalaseema through the Nallamala tunnels.
It carries Godavari water to North Coastal Andhra and Visakhapatnam.
48.x: The Polavaram Left Main Canal carries Godavari water towards North Coastal Andhra and Visakhapatnam.
48.tq: Distinguish the left and right canal functions through their destination regions.
xs: The **Polavaram Left Main Canal** carries **Godavari** water to **North Coastal Andhra and Visakhapatnam** — option **(4)** is correct.
**Poondi/Chennai** is **Telugu Ganga**; **Kurnool-Kadapa** is the **KC Canal**; the **Nallamala tunnels** are **Veligonda**.
xa: Godavari water was set to reach North Coastal Andhra on **2 Sep 2026** using pumps.
**27 TMC** is planned for the Visakhapatnam region, incl. **5 TMC** to the **Kanithi** reservoir at the steel plant.
A **Revised Administrative Sanction** was issued for the LMC (**Jun 2026**).

48.s: Polavaram Project is correctly described as a:
o: Canal project on the Tungabhadra under Section 90 of the Environment Protection Act
Lift scheme on the Pennar under the National Waterways Act
Multipurpose dam on the Krishna and a National Project under Section 89 of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014
Multipurpose dam on the Godavari and a National Project under Section 90 of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014
48.x: Polavaram is a multipurpose Godavari dam and a National Project under Section 90 of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014. Section 89 is not the applicable provision stated for it.
48.tq: Watch for the statutory-section swap, a common wrong-authority and wrong-provision trap.
xs: **Polavaram** is a **multipurpose dam on the Godavari** and a **National Project under Sec. 90, APRA 2014** — option **(4)** is correct.
⚠ Some notes (**Apr 2026**) wrongly cite **Sec. 89**; it is not on the Krishna, Tungabhadra or Pennar.
xa: It is at **Polavaram village**, erstwhile **West Godavari**.
**89% complete**; to be dedicated by **March 2027**.

48.s: Which of the following correctly gives the design features of Polavaram Project?
o: 149.6 TMC storage, 7.20 lakh acres irrigation, 690 MW power and 80 TMC diversion to the Pennar
194.6 TMC storage, 2.70 lakh acres irrigation, 960 MW power and 18 TMC diversion to the Krishna
294.6 TMC storage, 7.20 lakh acres irrigation, 960 MW power and 80 TMC diversion to the Godavari delta
194.6 TMC storage, 7.20 lakh acres irrigation, 960 MW power and 80 TMC diversion to the Krishna
48.x: The design figures are 194.6 TMC storage, irrigation potential of 7.20 lakh acres, 960 MW generation and diversion of 80 TMC to the Krishna.
48.tq: Match a project with its complete set of capacity figures and intended diversion.
xs: Design: **194.6 TMC** storage, **7.20 lakh acres**, **960 MW**, **80 TMC** to the **Krishna** — option **(4)** is correct.
The other options swap digits (149.6, 294.6, 690 MW, 2.70 lakh, 18 TMC) or the diversion target.
xa: It is a **National Project** under **Sec. 90, APRA 2014**.
Earlier progress: **78.64%** (**Dec 2024**); now **89%**.
The **Left Main Canal** serves North Coastal Andhra and Visakhapatnam.

48.s: According to the reported 2026 progress, Polavaram was targeted for dedication by:
48.x: The project was reported to be 89 percent complete and targeted for dedication by March 2027, before the Pushkarams. An earlier progress figure was 78.64 percent in December 2024.
48.tq: Distinguish the current progress target from the earlier progress figure.
xs: Polavaram is to be dedicated by **March 2027**, **before the Pushkarams** — option **(3)** is correct.
It was **89% complete** (**14 Jul 2026**).
xa: Earlier figure: **78.64%** (**Dec 2024**).
CM target: finish before the **2027 Godavari Pushkaralu** (**7 Apr 2026**).
**117** new Dowleswaram gates are also due before **Pushkarams 2027**.

48.s: The Veligonda project is associated with which basin combination?
o: Penna water to the Nagavali basin
Tungabhadra water to the Godavari basin
Godavari water to the Vamsadhara basin
Krishna water from Srisailam to the Gundlakamma basin
48.x: Veligonda conveys Krishna water from Srisailam into the Gundlakamma basin through Nallamala Sagar.
48.tq: Separate the source river from the receiving basin in an inter-basin transfer question.
xs: **Veligonda** carries **Krishna** water from **Srisailam** to the **Gundlakamma basin** — option **(4)** is correct.
It runs **through Nallamala tunnels**; it is also called **Nallamala Sagar**.
xa: It serves **Prakasam, Nellore, YSR Kadapa**.
**₹768 crore** paid to **6,206** displaced families (**Aug 2026**).
**Cumbum tank** is on the **Gundlakamma**.

48.s:
Consider the following statements about the Veligonda (Nallamala Sagar) project:
1. When complete it is to irrigate about 4.47 lakh acres.
2. Its Phase-II is to supply fluoride-free tap water to eastern Godavari delta villages.
3. Its Phase-I was slated for inauguration on 31 August 2026.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
48.x: Statement 1 is correct: total irrigation is about 4.47 lakh acres. Statement 2 is wrong: the fluoride-free tap water is for western Prakasam. Statement 3 is correct: Phase-I was slated for 31 Aug 2026. So '1 and 3 only'; options with 2 are wrong.
48.tq: Veligonda = Prakasam project; fluoride-free water goes to western Prakasam, not the Godavari delta.
xs: Statement 1 is correct: Veligonda will irrigate ~**4.47 lakh acres**.
Statement 3 is correct: **Phase-I** was slated for **31 Aug 2026** — option **(3) 1 and 3 only**.
Statement 2 is wrong: **Phase-II** gives **fluoride-free tap water** to **western Prakasam**, not the Godavari delta.
xa: Phase-II adds **3.283 lakh acres**.
Phase-I: **10.70 tmc ft**, **1.19 lakh acres**, drinking water for **4 lakh** people.
About **200 TMC** of Godavari water is planned via **Nallamala Sagar and Veligonda**.

48.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Telugu Ganga irrigates parts of Rayalaseema and Nellore.
2. Telugu Ganga supplies drinking water to Chennai.
3. Telugu Ganga carries Godavari water to the Krishna at Prakasam Barrage.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
48.x: Telugu Ganga serves Chennai and also irrigates Rayalaseema and Nellore. The diversion of Godavari water to the Krishna at Prakasam Barrage is the function of Pattiseema.
48.tq: Separate schemes by their source river, destination and beneficiary.
xs: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: **Telugu Ganga** irrigates **Rayalaseema and Nellore** and gives **drinking water to Chennai** — option **(1) 1 and 2 only**.
Statement 3 is wrong: Godavari water to the Krishna at **Prakasam Barrage** is **Pattiseema**; Telugu Ganga uses **Krishna** water from **Srisailam**.
xa: It irrigates **2.75 lakh acres** in **Kurnool and Kadapa** (**2026**).
Route: **Srisailam → Somasila → Kandaleru → Poondi**.
**10 tmc ft** to be released for Chennai in **2026**.

48.s: Galeru-Nagari Project is intended to carry Krishna flood water to:
48.x: Galeru-Nagari carries Krishna flood water to Kadapa and Chittoor districts.
48.tq: Recall the beneficiary districts of a regional irrigation scheme.
xs: **Galeru-Nagari** takes **Krishna flood water** to **Kadapa and Chittoor** — option **(1)** is correct.
**Kurnool and Kadapa** are served by the **KC Canal**; **North Coastal Andhra** by the **Polavaram LMC**.
xa: **Veligonda** serves **Prakasam, Nellore, YSR Kadapa**.
**Telugu Ganga** also irrigates Rayalaseema and Nellore.
The **Polavaram-Nallamala Sagar** link would send Godavari flood water to **Rayalaseema**.

48.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Telugu Ganga Project:
1. It takes Krishna water from Srisailam.
2. It supplies water to Chennai.
3. It irrigates areas in Kurnool and Kadapa.
4. It was conceived by N. T. Rama Rao.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
48.x: The Telugu Ganga Project takes Krishna water from Srisailam, supplies Chennai, irrigates 2.75 lakh acres in Kurnool and Kadapa, and was conceived by N. T. Rama Rao.
48.tq: Check each statement against the project’s source, beneficiaries, irrigation purpose and origin.
xs: All four are correct: **Krishna** water from **Srisailam**, supplies **Chennai**, irrigates **Kurnool and Kadapa**, conceived by **N.T. Rama Rao** — option **(4) 1, 2, 3 and 4**.
The Kurnool-Kadapa area is **2.75 lakh acres** (**2026**).
xa: Inaugurated in the **7th Plan (1985-90)**.
**Maharashtra, Karnataka and AP** each gave up **5 tmc** = **15 tmc**.
It also supplies bulk water to **Naidupeta**.

48.s: The Telugu Ganga Project was inaugurated during which Five-Year Plan period?
48.x: The Telugu Ganga Project was inaugurated during the Seventh Five-Year Plan, covering 1985–90.
48.tq: Discriminate between closely placed Five-Year Plan periods using the stated year range.
xs: **Telugu Ganga** was inaugurated in the **7th Plan (1985-90)** — option **(1)** is correct.
It was conceived by **N.T. Rama Rao**.
xa: Beneficiary state: **Tamil Nadu** (**APHQ 2025**).
Route ends at **Poondi** (TN).
**15 tmc** for Chennai from three states.

48.s: Which State is identified as the beneficiary State of the Telugu Ganga Project?
48.x: Tamil Nadu is the beneficiary State of the Telugu Ganga Project because the project supplies water to Chennai.
48.tq: Use the beneficiary-state trap by separating the source and transit States from the receiving State.
xs: The beneficiary state of **Telugu Ganga** is **Tamil Nadu** — option **(4)** is correct.
It supplies drinking water to **Chennai** (**APHQ 2025**).
**Maharashtra, Karnataka** and **AP** are the states that **gave up** water (**5 tmc** each).
xa: Water source: **Krishna** surplus at **Srisailam**.
**10 tmc ft** to be released for Chennai in **2026**.
Route: **Srisailam → Somasila → Kandaleru → Poondi**.

48.s: Which one of the following correctly represents the principal route of the Telugu Ganga Project?
48.x: The route runs from Srisailam through the Penna basin at Somasila, then Kandaleru, and finally Poondi in Tamil Nadu.
48.tq: Follow the route in source-to-destination order and reject reversed sequences.
xs: Route: **Srisailam → Penna basin (Somasila) → Kandaleru → Poondi (TN)** — option **(2)** is correct.
It starts at Srisailam, so options starting at **Somasila** or **Kandaleru** fail; **Dowleswaram** and **Polavaram** are Godavari sites.
xa: **Somasila** is on the **Penna** (SPSR Nellore).
Telugu Ganga irrigates **2.75 lakh acres** in Kurnool and Kadapa.
It supplies bulk water to the **Naidupeta** cluster.

48.s: Maharashtra, Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh each gave up how much water for the Telugu Ganga Project, together providing 15 TMC for Chennai?
48.x: Each of the three States gave up 5 TMC, making a total of 15 TMC for Chennai.
48.tq: Solve the contribution-total relationship instead of relying only on the aggregate figure.
xs: **Maharashtra, Karnataka and AP** each gave up **5 tmc** — option **(1)** is correct.
⚠ Together that makes **15 tmc** for Chennai — **15** is the total, not each state's share.
xa: **10 tmc ft** to be released for Chennai in **2026**.
The Krishna basin states are **AP, Maharashtra, Karnataka**.
Conceived by **N.T. Rama Rao**.

48.s: Besides its drinking-water function, the Telugu Ganga canal also supplies bulk water to which industrial cluster?
48.x: The canal also supplies bulk water to the Naidupeta industrial cluster.
48.tq: Test the secondary use of a project rather than its more familiar primary purpose.
xs: Telugu Ganga supplies bulk water to the **Naidupeta** industrial cluster — option **(4)** is correct.
**Sri City, Visakhapatnam, Kurnool** clusters are not named in the notes.
xa: Reported in **2025-26**.
Its main role: **drinking water to Chennai**.
It also irrigates **Rayalaseema and Nellore**.

48.s: Which of the following river links is correctly matched with its stated feature?
o: Nagavali–Suvarnamukhi — intended for Rayalaseema irrigation only
Godavari–Penna Phase-I — a four-river link with no lifting component
48.x: The Godavari–Krishna link is functioning through Pattiseema. Vamsadhara–Nagavali was about 73% complete, Nagavali–Suvarnamukhi serves Vizianagaram drinking water, and Godavari–Penna Phase-I involves a five-stage lift.
48.tq: Start with the sure project-feature pair and eliminate reversed descriptions.
xs: **Godavari–Krishna — Pattiseema is working** is correct — option **(2)** is correct: Pattiseema already lifts Godavari water to the Krishna at **Prakasam Barrage**.
**Nagavali-Suvarnamukhi** is for **Vizianagaram drinking water**; **Godavari-Penna Phase-I** is a **5-stage lift**; **Vamsadhara-Nagavali** is only **73%** done (target **June 2027**).
xa: Pattiseema diverted **17.52 tmc ft** by **10 Aug 2026**.
Godavari-Penna Phase-I: **73 TMC**, **7,000 cusecs**, ~**21%** done.
AP plans to finish **Vamsadhara-Nagavali** by December.

48.s: The Polavaram–Nallamala Sagar link, earlier known as the Banakacherla link, is intended to:
o: Link the Vamsadhara and Nagavali rivers exclusively for hydropower
Transfer Krishna water to coastal Odisha through Hirakud
Supply only drinking water to Vizianagaram through Suvarnamukhi
Transfer Godavari floodwater to Rayalaseema through Bollapalli
48.x: The Polavaram–Nallamala Sagar link proposes transfer of Godavari floodwater to Rayalaseema through Bollapalli.
48.tq: Discriminate between links by their route and purpose.
xs: The **Polavaram-Nallamala Sagar** (earlier **Banakacherla**) link sends **Godavari flood water to Rayalaseema via Bollapalli** — option **(4)** is correct.
It is not a Vamsadhara-Nagavali, Odisha or Vizianagaram scheme.
xa: Reservoirs at **Bollapalli (Guntur)** and **Banakacherla (Nandyal)**.

Statement 2 is correct: winter temperatures are about **13-30° C**.
Statement 3 is wrong: occasional winter rain comes from **retreating systems + western disturbances**, not the SW monsoon (**June-September**).
xa: Seasons: summer **March to mid-June**, SW monsoon **mid-June to September**, retreating monsoon **October-December**.

o: Pre-monsoon showers of April-May that help mangoes ripen
Winter rain from western disturbances in January-February
The heaviest south-west monsoon rains of July

49.s: The total rainfall during June–December in Andhra Pradesh in 2024-25 was:

49.s: The IMD report on observed rainfall variability and changes over Andhra Pradesh ranks which region as having the lowest annual rainfall?

49.s: Which statement best describes Andhra Pradesh in relation to winter rainfall in neighbouring regions?

49.s:
